sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops third-party analytics and tracking in the Hulu phone app: AppsFlyer, Adobe, Conviva, Nielsen, and Firebase/Google Analytics. Blocking happens on the device, inside the app. Hulu's own analytics share servers with sign-in and playback…

Stops the Play Store from silently replacing the patched app with the official version, which would bring the ads back. It raises the app's version number far ahead of the Store's, so the Store sees it as up to date. You can still update o…

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Hides an active VPN from the app's on-device checks, so it sees the network the VPN runs over. The app can still tell from your IP address on its servers. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

Makes the app see an unmetered Wi-Fi connection when the phone is on mobile data, so Wi-Fi-only downloads and quality limits do not apply. This can use a lot of mobile data. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
Removes the ads stitched into on-demand videos in the Hulu phone app, so titles play without ad breaks. Live TV is not changed. Experimental; test on-device.

Hides your mobile carrier from the app and the ad and analytics SDKs inside it, or reports a carrier name you choose. Carrier deals the app detects from your carrier will not work while this is on. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
